cards.card_text: But Paul says this person has a hard and unrepentant heart, and because of it, he's piling something up against himself for later.
cards.verse_text: But because of your hard and unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
